name: Outlook
description: Search, read, send, reply, forward, move, flag, categorise and delete Outlook mail, and call any Microsoft Graph mail or calendar endpoint, from any session. Every write waits for your confirm.

connections.why: Reads and changes your mail, sends mail you confirm, and reads and changes your calendar for the outlook_* tools. Every write waits for your confirm.

settings.label: Microsoft account
settings.description: Which connected Microsoft account the tools use, by its address or connection id. Empty: the first one. A tool's account argument overrides it.
